babs.2: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And when your Lord said to the angels: I will place a successor on earth"
babs.5: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Indeed, We sent Nuh to his people …"
babs.6: "And indeed, Ilyas was among the messengers …"
babs.8: The saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: "As for 'Ad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind"
babs.9: The story of Gog and Magog
babs.10: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And Allah took Ibrahim as an intimate friend"
babs.11: His saying, Mighty and Majestic: "And inform them about the guests of Ibrahim"
babs.12: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And mention in the Book Isma'il; he was true to his promise"
babs.14: "Or were you witnesses when death approached Ya'qub?"
babs.15: "And Lut, when he said to his people: Do you commit immorality while you see it? …"
babs.16: "And when the messengers came to the family of Lut …"
babs.17: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And to Thamud their brother Salih"
babs.18: "Or were you witnesses when death approached Ya'qub?"
babs.19: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Certainly in Yusuf and his brothers there are signs for those who ask"
babs.20: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And Ayyub, when he called to his Lord: Adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful"
babs.22: "And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh said …"
babs.23: The saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: "Has the story of Musa reached you, when he saw a fire?"
babs.24: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Has the story of Musa reached you?"
babs.25: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And We appointed for Musa thirty nights and completed them with ten …"
babs.28: "… who were devoted to their idols"
babs.30: The death of Musa and what was mentioned of him afterwards
babs.31: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And Allah presents an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh"
babs.33: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And indeed, Yunus was among the messengers"
babs.34: "And ask them about the town that was by the sea …"
babs.35: The prayer most beloved to Allah is the prayer of Dawud
babs.36: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And We certainly gave Luqman wisdom …"
babs.37: "And present to them an example: the people of the town"
babs.38: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And mention in the Book Maryam …"
babs.39: "And when the angels said: O Maryam, Allah has chosen you and purified you …"
babs.40: What is mentioned about the Children of Israel
babs.41: The story of the leper, the blind man and the bald man among the Children of Israel
